decision_conditions: <div>The proposed outbuilding,&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">by virtue of its excessive depth and orientation, would result in an unacceptable loss of daylight and overshadowing to&nbsp;the adjoining property at no.8 Eliot Road.</span>, therefore constituting unneighbourly development which is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><ul><li><span style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF)&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-size: 11pt;">(December 2024);</span></li><li><span style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span></span></li><li><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policies DMD1, DMD5,&nbsp;<span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">DMSI3</span></span>&nbsp;and SP2 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham's Local Plan (September 2024);</span></li><li><span style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);</span></span></li></ul></div>

<div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The proposed outbuilding, by virtue of its significant scale and footprint which exceeds the footprint of the main dwelling, would result in a dominant and disproportionate form of development within the rear garden which&nbsp;fails to respect the character and appearance of the host dwelling and pattern of development, notably</span>&nbsp;given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate.<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;Furthermore, it may not be considered to be ancillary to the main dwelling as it&nbsp;could be used as for semi-independent or residential purposes. </span>As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">-
